decisions.action: Parsed Invoice_Date to datetime and derived calendar Date.
Kept all rows. Duplicate Invoice_ID values (62 extra occurrences) belong to different dates/cities/categories and are not identical transactions. Invoice_ID is not treated as a unique key.
Validated required numeric fields. No negatives and no non-numeric values.
Did not remove high-revenue invoices. Large values may be legitimate multi-unit sales. Revenue 99th percentile=1218.75, max=1443.13.
Did not impute Customer_Age. Missing ages are retained as null and excluded from age-specific analytics. Customer_Age is not used as a forecasting feature.
Did not impute Customer_Gender. Missing gender is reported as 'Not available in the current dataset' in gender breakdowns.
